lean_scaffold:
-- IGProtocol scaffold: VINIT → AFWD → CLINK → FSPLIT → EVALT → AFWD → EVALF → AREV → ENGAGR → FFUSE → IMSCRIB → IFIX → TANCH
-- (native ob3ect designer; elaborate against the kernel to verify)
name: test vessel for alkahest

phase_0.boundary_condition: sealed test cell with locked lid and rating plate that contains the alkahest charge and the vessel coupon
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: measured drop carried forward from reservoir ampoule into the cup

AREV.chosen_element: sump return for mass loss weighing
AREV.justification: residue and rinsate drawn back down to the sump pan to weigh wall loss

CLINK.chosen_element: lid seal chained to thermal soak
CLINK.justification: closure torque followed in order by timed heating so contact conditions stay linked

ENGAGR.justification: intact patches and breached patches held together on the same coupon at once

EVALF.justification: wall surface denied as breached with pits, thinning and weight loss

EVALT.justification: wall surface affirmed as unbroken with thickness within tolerance

FFUSE.chosen_element: rating junction at the bench recorder
FFUSE.justification: hold reading and dissolve reading meet as one vessel rating on the log sheet

FSPLIT.chosen_element: bifurcation into hold arm and dissolve arm
FSPLIT.justification: one trial opens into intact wall behavior and pitted wall behavior

IFIX.justification: final rating cut into steel plate and stored in the archive rack beyond alteration

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: etched serial mark on the coupon
IMSCRIB.justification: cup reads as itself by its own fired mark under the assay lens

TANCH.justification: lid locked and ports capped so the trial mass stays accounted inside the cell

VINIT.chosen_element: empty quartz assay cup on the bench
VINIT.justification: cup washed, dried and weighed with no alkahest charge present

phase_2.fuse_element: rating junction at the bench recorder
phase_2.fuse_result: single vessel rating that carries both hold measurement and loss measurement
phase_2.rejoin_note: hold arm records thickness and lens continuity while dissolve arm drains to sump for weighing, then both arms rejoin at the rating junction for the log entry
phase_2.split_element: bifurcation into hold arm and dissolve arm
phase_2.split_input: sealed cup with alkahest charge under thermal soak
split_outputs: dissolution arm with pitting and mass loss
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) both: intact zones and breached zones present together on one coupon
phase_3.false_description: B4 F (10) refuted: wall continuity negated by pits and measured mass loss
phase_3.true_description: B4 T (01) proven: wall continuity measured and affirmed under lens and caliper
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) neither: cup empty and no contact between alkahest and wall established

steps.domain_action: empty assay cup staged and tared before charge
metered drop of alkahest delivered into the cup
lid sealed to cup then thermal soak started in order
trial opens into containment arm and dissolution arm
glaze observed continuous and thickness in tolerance
wall thickness carried forward to hold measurement
glaze observed pitted with thinning and weight loss
residue returned to sump for mass loss weighing
intact reading and breached reading held together on one coupon
both arms rejoin into single vessel rating
coupon self identifies by its etched serial mark
final rating etched into furnace log plate
test cell sealed and archived with rating plate

phase_5.alfs_store: alkahest assay ledger that stores prior cup ratings and reference etchings
phase_5.compiler_frontend: assay protocol sheet that turns charge volume and soak time into bench actions
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: tray handoff and spoken callouts between charge station, furnace and lens bench
phase_5.memory_mechanism: balance slips, lens photographs and sump pans retained by coupon serial
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: soak timer and furnace queue that orders charge, heat, observe and weigh

phase_6.cycle_cost: measured alkahest volume, heat for soak and coupon wear per trial
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — charge plus cup plus log account for all mass and marks in the closed cell
phase_6.post_cycle_state: stained cup with spent charge in sump and filled rating on log plate
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: clean tared cup with full reservoir ampoule and blank log sheet
